_comment: Player moves and movement for the fight scene (issues #10 and #12, spec docs/specs/player-controls.md). Timings are whole simulation ticks at tickRate (60 ticks = 1 second; seconds in each _comment are for humans only). Distances are metres along the side-on X axis, measured between fighter root positions. All values are GAMEPLAY ABSTRACTION tuning values, not measured boxing data; the boxing review (work/10) set the jab/cross gap so the cross is a bit slower and heavier, not clearly slower. Issue #12 adds stance: the jab is always the LEAD hand and the cross the REAR hand; which glove that is depends on the boxer's stance (orthodox = left lead, southpaw = right lead). Stance never changes a timing, reach or cancel below.

stance._comment: Stance chosen per boxer in Character Select (issue #12). Allowed values: "orthodox" (left hand and left foot lead) or "southpaw" (the mirror: right hand and right foot lead). default = the stance each Character Select step starts on, and the stance of both fighters on a direct launch of the ring. Any other value fails at load naming stance.default.

jab._comment: Lead-hand straight. Key J. Left glove in orthodox, right glove in southpaw. 6/3/9 ticks = 0.10 s / 0.05 s / 0.15 s, total 18 ticks = 0.30 s. Startup matches a measured throw-to-contact of about 0.12 s; the total is deliberately snappier than a real whole punch (about 0.4 to 0.5 s). Recovery can be cancelled into the cross (the one-two), in either stance.

cross._comment: Rear-hand straight. Key K. Right glove in orthodox, left glove in southpaw. 8/4/14 ticks = 0.13 s / 0.07 s / 0.23 s, total 26 ticks = 0.43 s (about 1.44 x the jab total). A bit slower and heavier than the jab, slightly longer reach; the gap is small on purpose because real jab and cross speeds are close. Keep the cross total <= 1.5 x the jab total so the one-two stays usable (checked by AC3).

slipLeft._comment: Slip to the boxer's own left (away from the side-on camera for the player), in either stance. Key Q. 3/15/12 ticks = 0.05 s / 0.25 s / 0.20 s, total 0.50 s. Evading only during active. Recovery can be cancelled into a jab or a cross (counter) but not into another slip. No source gives real slip durations: tuning values. Same as slipRight on purpose; separate entry so the two sides can be tuned apart later.

slipRight._comment: Slip to the boxer's own right (toward the side-on camera for the player), in either stance. Key E. Same timings and cancels as slipLeft (see there).

guard._comment: Hold to guard. 4 ticks = 0.07 s before blocking counts. Walking speed is multiplied while guard is raising or up.

movement._comment: Walk speed in m/s. minX is the furthest the player can back up (must be <= fighters.json ring.playerX and on the visible floor). minSeparationM is the closest the player's root may get to the opponent's root.

feedback._comment: On-screen 'Contact: Jab' / 'Contact: Cross' text duration. 45 ticks = 0.75 s.

visual._comment: Pose offsets for the code-driven move animation, fractions of fighter height (H) or width (W) as in fighters.json body. Developer may tune within about 30 percent so the move reads well; tune so a punch at gap == its reach visibly reaches the opponent. Values are written for the orthodox stance; a southpaw uses the same numbers mirrored (lead/rear glove roles swap between GloveL and GloveR, and the sign of every boxer-sideways offset and every stance turn flips). punchExtendH = forward glove travel for the jab and the cross. crossTorsoTurnDeg = torso/shoulder/head turn for the cross, rear shoulder forward (right shoulder in orthodox, left in southpaw). The jab has no turn. Slip (both sides, both stances, NOT mirrored by stance because the side is the boxer's own left or right): slipHeadDropH = upper-body dip; slipLeanDeg = roll toward the chosen side about the facing axis; slipTurnDeg = shoulder turn about the vertical axis, opposite sign for the two sides.
